newsitem.title: USA: Henkel Corp sues Inspec unit in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: Henkel Corp sues Inspec unit in patent dispute.

text.p: The U.S. unit of Henkel KGaA has sued Allco Chemical Corp, a division of Britain's Inspec Group Plc, alleging Allco infringed a Henkel patent for recovering metals by solvent extraction.

In papers filed Wednesday in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Henkel Corp seeks a court order barring Allco from further alleged infrigement and an award of damages, tripled for "willful" infringement.
Henkel is Germany's fourth-largest chemical company and a leading producer of metal surface treatments.
Allco, which Inspec acquired in February from AlliedSignal Inc for $28.7 million, produces speciality acids and anhydrides for polyimide resins. Allco is based in Galena, Kansas.
A spokesman for Allco was not available for comment.
